newsitem.title: UK: IBCA gives Hanil Bank C individual rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA gives Hanil Bank C individual rating.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Thursday it assigned Korea's Hanil Bank an individual rating of C.

The bank's previously assigned legal rating of 2 remains unchanged, reflecting IBCA's view that the Korean authorities would not allow the failure of any of the country's major banks, IBCA said in a statement.
IBCA said the bank's individual rating reflected its slightly better financial condition compared with its peer group.

"Hanil is the second largest commercial bank in Korea in terms of consolidated equity and assets. It shares many features in common with its peers among the former government-owned large commercial banks, namely weak profitability and poor asset quality, arising in large meeasure from government-directed lending in earlier years," the rating agency said.
"However, Hanil's performance has been slightly better than its peers because of its better asset quality: it has a lower average exposure to the troubled construction sector," IBCA said.
